claims.disproof_condition: 條件：表後燃氣電廠的許可或整合商申報普遍寫明只接管線氣、不用槽車 LNG／CNG，或 Stabilis／Certarus 的資料中心合約提前終止。核查頻率：每季。觸發後 48 小時：重讀這一層是過渡用還是常設。
claims.statement: Trucked LNG is used to fuel behind-the-meter and temporary power generation at data centers: Stabilis (10-Q, Q2 2026) holds a multi-year contract to supply LNG for behind-the-meter power generation at a data center (deliveries 2027Q1–2029Q1) and a second contract (signed 2026-07-09) to fuel temporary power generation at a data center. It is a bridge/temporary fuel layer — the filing does not say whether pipeline gas later replaces it.

claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Stabilis 之後的 10-Q／10-K 寫出合約取消、交貨延後、退回預付款，或客戶付款違約。核查頻率：每季（Stabilis 10-Q）。觸發後 48 小時：降這條邊 confidence，重讀過渡供氣層。
claims.statement: Stabilis (10-Q, Q2 2026): in February 2026 won a multi-year take-or-pay contract, about USD 200 million over the initial term (deliveries 2027Q1–2029Q1), to supply LNG for behind-the-meter power generation at a data center to a world-leading provider of remote and temporary power generation (customer not named); USD 25 million advance payments; a second data-center temporary power fuel contract signed 2026-07-09. Against Q2 2026 total revenue of USD 11.9 million (down 31.2%), the contract is large relative to the company.

sources.quote: In February 2026, the Company was awarded a multi-year take-or-pay contract to supply LNG for behind-the-meter power generation for a world-leading provider of remote and temporary power generation at a data center.

LNG deliveries are expected to commence during the first quarter of 2027 and continue through the first quarter of 2029. Total revenue under the initial multi-year term of the contract is estimated to be approximately $200 million.

The Company will receive $25.0 million in advance payments from the customer; of which, $20.0 million has been received at June 30, 2026 and an additional $5.0 million advance payment was received in the third quarter of 2026.

On July 9, 2026, the Company signed a contract commencing in the third quarter of 2026 to fuel temporary power generation at a data center that is anticipated to replace a significant portion of lost volumes from prior periods.
